name: BioLatent
description: BioLatent is a reproducible benchmark of frozen molecular, protein and genomic representations under a common evaluation procedure. This release contains aggregate benchmark results, per-example test predictions, paired statistical comparisons, split and seed sensitivity analyses, pretraining-exposure proxies, literature-to-measured matching data, run manifests and the source tables for all manuscript figures. The release covers nine public real-data tasks, 18 representations and 68 measured model–dataset evaluations. Raw third-party datasets and pretrained embedding matrices are not redistributed. Dataset provenance and pinned reproduction code are available at https://github.com/yboulaamane/biolatent.
